content.hebrew: אֶל מִי תְדַמְּיוּן אֵל? וּמַעֲשָׂיו לוֹ עֵדִים.
content.transliteration: El mi tedammeyun El? Uma‘asav lo ‘edim.
content.english: To whom can you compare God? His deeds are testimony about Him.
He causes meritorious action through the pious,
Who have had their ears pierced to be slaves to Him.
He gives strength to the weary, and bequeaths [possessions] to the indigent.
He prepares verbal expression, and gives erudite eloquence.

content.hebrew: שָׂם מַעֲנֶה בְּפִי גוּר אַרְיֵה, וְדִבֶּר נְגִידִים,
content.transliteration: Sam ma‘anē befi ḡur aryē vedibber neḡidim,
content.english: He placed an answer in the mouth of the lion’s whelp, such that he spoke nobly,

content.hebrew: מָשַׁךְ לֵב נִמְשָׁל לְשׁוֹר, בְּמִלִּים נֶחְמָדִים.
content.transliteration: Mashakh lev nimshal leshor, bemillim neḥmadim.
content.english: And [the lion] tugged on the heartstrings of the one compared to an ox, with pleasing words.
content.comments: The one compared to an ox. Joseph.

content.hebrew: כִּי נִסָּם עַד הֵאָסֵף מִרְיָם, וַיִּהְיוּ נֹדְדִים.
content.transliteration: Ki nissam ‘ad he’asef Miryam, vayyihyu nodedim.
content.english: Indeed, [Joseph] was testing them until their rebelliousness would cease, and they were wandering.
It was through the mellifluous speech of Judah that they became united.

content.hebrew: וְלֹא יָכֹל יוֹסֵף לְהִתְאַפֵּק לַאֲשֶׁר עָלָיו שֹׁקְדִים,
content.transliteration: Velo yakhol Yosef lehitappeḳ la’asher ‘alav shoḳedim,
content.english: And Joseph could no [longer] restrain himself in [the presence of] those waiting on him,
And he said: “Remove everyone standing in front of me!”
And when his brothers heard “I am Joseph!” they stood trembling.
[He continued]: “Go up to my father – be reverentially obedient!

content.hebrew: יְמַהֵר לָבוֹא, וּבִפְקֻדַּת הַשָּׁלוֹם תִּהְיוּ נִפְקָדִים.
content.transliteration: Yemaher lavo, uvifḳuddat hash’shalom tihyu nifḳadim.
content.english: May he hasten to come [to me], and may peace be your lot.
I shall sustain [you all], sires and sired,

content.hebrew: כִּי לָשׂוּם לָכֶם שְׁאֵרִית שְׁלָחַֽנִי מוֹשִׁיב בַּֽיְתָה יְחִידִים."
content.transliteration: Ki lasum lakhem she’erit shelaḥani moshiv bayta yeḥidim.”
content.english: For He has sent me to give you continuity—He who brings individuals to dwell in a household.”
Who is like Adonai, who separates those who are joined?
And who is a guide like Him, who joins those that are separated?
And who is like Him, who gives rest to wanderers and vagabonds?

content.hebrew: כִּי מִי אֱלֽוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יוי מֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־רֹדִים?
content.transliteration: Ki mi elo’ah mibbal‘adē Adomay moshel bekhol rodim?
content.english: For who is a god other than Adonai, who rules over all rulers?

content.hebrew: וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ הַכֹּל מוֹדִים?
content.transliteration: Umi tsur zulati elohenu hakkol modim?
content.english: And who is a rock other than our God, whom all acknowledge?
All praise Him, and all declare the oneness of His name—
Congregation: And all attest: “There is none holy like Adonai.”

content.hebrew: חזן: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: Cantor: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none besides You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are holy, enthroned upon Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
